added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest records baseline_suite: null and after_suite: null, so no base and head gate logs exist to derive an added-failure count from; recorded as 0/[] only because the delivery contract requires an integer, and it must not be read as a measured zero.

findings.text: non-blocking: the node goal and plan section 4 name the engine's entry as where endpoints.json publishes the checkpoint, but write_endpoint_document emits it in a top-level checkpoints map at registry.py:674; the deviation is justified and reported -- the deployed generated launcher validates an entry against an exact key set at imas_ambix/agent/clive.py:328 and fails closed on any other field -- but it changes the published-document contract the goal states and needs coordinator adjudication rather than silent acceptance.

non-blocking: the node's landing contract states that because its done-when names no artifact it writes no figure, yet it wrote document-shape.svg; the figure renders cleanly and the declared write paths grant the figures directory, so this may be intended, but the record should say which of the two governs.

item_verdicts.call_sites: verified the production paths that reach the change: the endpoint publish path, the serve and restart script generator, and the receipts recorder.
item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit against base f49f6d5; five commits, eight files, and commit 8e3fa67f deliberately moves the checkpoint from an engine-entry field to a top-level checkpoints map with its reason in the body.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py + tests/test_agent_endpoint_discovery.py + tests/test_agent_serving_receipts.py and ruff; the manifest records that gate at rev 22ee7573 with 81 passed and ruff exit 0.
item_verdicts.goal: the goal is to record on the registration and in endpoints.json the hf_repo@revision a serve loaded; read imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:606 and imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:674 and found the registration and the published document both carry it.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states status complete, names the gate command and four test log paths, and states both negative controls' results.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared paths (eight entries); the diff's eight files are all inside them.

justifications.durability: the entry-key-set assertion at tests/test_agent_serve_registry.py:405 names the base revision's seven fields literally, and the recorded control shows restoring checkpoint as an entry field reddens it (logs/negative-control-entry-key-set.log, 10 failed / EXIT=1), so it fails on the regression it guards.
justifications.evidence: the manifest's gate line is exactly the done_when's three files and its log (logs/gate-checkpoints-map.log, header 'rev 22ee7573', tail '81 passed' / 'EXIT=0') records the same run, with ruff exit 0 and two red negative controls.
justifications.fit: the added field follows the surrounding dataclass idiom at imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:125 with a mechanism docstring, and the added vocabulary entry at imas_ambix/agent/serving_receipts.py:144 sits in the existing SERVE_CONFIG_OPTIONS tuple with the file's launcher-flag mapping comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: imas_ambix/agent/registry.py:125 and imas_ambix/agent/slurm.py:606 carry the loaded checkpoint on the registration and publish it in endpoints.json, meeting the goal's substance; the publication is a top-level map at registry.py:674 rather than the engine entry the goal names, a forced and reported deviation (see finding).
justifications.reuse: no capability is forked: ServeRegistration and EndpointDocument are extended in place, SERVE_CONFIG_OPTIONS gains one name, and the engine-over-caller precedence for model_path is the existing merge path exercised at tests/test_agent_serving_receipts.py:1495, not a new one.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path the diff touches is inside the declared write paths, but the node's landing contract stated it writes no figure and it wrote docs/figures/rotate-to-deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017/serve-records-its-checkpoint/document-shape.svg (see finding).
